notes.title: BIG UPDATE May 27, 2017
notes.notes:
In-Game & User Interfaces
Major changes on overall interface structure
We received several feedback that the interface does not match the game. We changed the structure of the overall interface significantly, including font. To briefly compare the differences:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/ce364201d8aeb66c8d539fe08356b0d10428c3f8.png


Redesigned icons of weapons and skills
The previous icons were hard to figure out what kind of attack the weapon fires. We've redesigned the icons to make it more intuitive. Check out the difference:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/3e5465185e16f72847174ac6324b0d3e5b9ac0ef.png


Anti-alias
We have trimmed the aliases which appeared in some enemies, especially triangular ones.


Controller Support
Now the game provides full controller support! Every menu in the game can be navigated using the controller. Current default key settings are:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/f8ea424eaa449194aa4b11391dfc9c8bf9348d86.png
We are still discussing whether to change the roles of bumpers(LB, RB) and triggers(LT, RT). We will make decisions based on user feedbacks—or adding a key configuration options may be a solution.


Steamworks
Achievements
The achievements are finally here! There are 15 achievements now(including 4 hidden ones!), and more will be added soon! If you have any idea, please share it; we will reflect it in future updates.

Hello World!
Run the game for the first time

a²d²B²
Defeat 'Bad Squares'

Hexagons are the Bestagons
Defeat 'Hexagonal'

Like a Record
Defeat 'Hyper Spin'

New World Order?
Defeat 'Trianglism'

Points, Lines, Planes
Defeat 'Geometry'

Identical
Defeat 'Twins'

Smoothly done
Defeat 'Surface'

88 mph
Defeat 'Time'

Revelation
Defeat 'Space'

Let There Be Light
Defeat 'Reverse'

???
Hidden achievement

???
Hidden achievement

???
Hidden achievement

???
Hidden achievement


Trading Cards
Steam Trading Cards and related items were added! There're 10 cards in total, plus 10 emoticons and 5 Steam Profile Backgrounds.

Cards
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/e83be8dbf1aff9085b63ccf09a188ccf3ae8beea.png

Badges
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/9be17eae5da97d59989daec1ac03086d87fb5b7b.png

Emoticons
Emoticons carries icons of weapons and skills. To find out what it looks like, please check out the Redesigned icons of weapons and skills section in this patch note.

Steam Profile Backgrounds
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/aa0df8a3b32c2dfdbb9a5578fb3d1f0496c54b60.png


Pricing
As more content was added, we raised the price from $1.99 to $3.99. Prices in other regions would have been raised at a similar rate. But we promise that we'll hold sales more often, at larger discount rates. The previous price was hard to do so.



P.S. We apologize for the long blank period before the update. We would like to express our sincere appreciation for your continued interest and encouragement. As always, thank you for playing, and we hope you have a nice day.

notes.title: Update rollback due to maintenance issues
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Due to a problem during the preparation process for the controller support, we temporarily suspended the update plan and restored the game to its previous state.

Now the game works as before. Sorry for the inconvenience, and we sincerely apologize for the long silence.

notes.title: Update Nov. 22, 2016
notes.notes:
Balancing

Stage 9('Space') Boss's hit point has decreased.
The damage done by Weapon 3(Minigun) has been reduced.
Weapon 3(Minigun)'s bullets spread more widely than before.
The damage done by Weapon 4(Laser gun) has been reduced.
The shots of Weapon 4(Laser gun) remains longer than before.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where a frame drop occurred intermittently when using Weapon 4(Laser gun).
The Fullscreen on/off toggle will now be saved properly.(However the Button Position option is not yet. We are working on this.)


Miscellaneous

Now when you clear the stage, "VICTORY" is displayed instead of "GAME OVER" text.
